title: docs(pm-dispatch): a project-run seat form beside the Routine form — the seat post as a stub, the dispatch order in the card thread, event wake plus one patrol per project, 项目总监 → 总监席

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能里加一种「项目席」形态,与 Routine 席并列:席位会话是车道项目的线程时,座位贴降为存根(只留别的账号要读的四项:在座账号与项目、上任时刻、热文件串行队、指针行,外加可选撞墙注记),姿态、台账、班次叙事与轮报住项目;派发令由协调者写进卡线程开场消息,不再落共享目录;唤醒 = 每张卡 PR 的订阅事件 + 每项目一个 2–4 小时巡查 routine,不再有自绑 cron、`send_later` 链与跨墙定时器链;轮报 = 卡线程清单,五项健康指标进总监项目的每日摘要;「项目总监」改称「总监席」、「项目协调者」改称「协调者」,GitHub 的 org Project 改称「看板」,并在入口表定义「车道项目」与「总监项目」。第五个提交是卡上预告的跟进:coordinator.md 落地后补指针与改名,两处「派发令文件」改「派发令全文」,巡查行点名前提过时检查,cross-repo 规则 5 的 org Project 也改「看板」。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-10-23 在「车队机制迁往 Projects」线程的原话:「同意，你现在就立卡派发处理。」(对调研备忘推荐字母 1B 2A 3B 4B 5B 与第 9 节命名的同意)。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本,八个文件行数全部净零、每行 ≤120 字节,无上限抬高;一次 revert 可回。两处要您知道:① 卡上第 3 项「线程开起前先命名分支」实测做不到——分支由平台在线程建立那一刻指定,协调者只能在线程建起之后读到它;您 2026-10-23 11:29 在决裁批 #4 裁了 1A(协调者开线程即读分支交席位、席位认领、线程核对),第三个提交已照裁写进 runbook 〈卡线程〉与 os-dev.md 规则 1(卡线程不推空分支)。② 为付行数删掉了三条 Routine 席专用规则(自绑 cron、`send_later` 加速器、跨墙每小时 cron 链),正是卡上点名的付账行;维护者在 UI 建的 Routine 席不受影响;同批 2A 补上直连会话的唤醒规则(按召唤跑,⛔ 无自醒不常驻),写在 SKILL.md 分诊席那一行。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:等席位对新 head 的契约复核 PASS、CI 全绿后说一句「可以落地」。

## What changed

## Item 3 — filed as `needs_decision`, ruled 1A in batch #4, written in the third commit

Ruling record: card comment 6363872862 (maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T11:29Z = 1A 2A). The text below is the analysis as filed; the ruled shape is option A, now on `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L141–L142 and `os-dev.md` rule 1 (see the table above). Item 2 of that batch (2A, the direct-session wake rule) is on SKILL.md L75 (L74 before the merge added the `coordinator` row).

The card's item 3 (「branch named before the thread opens」: the seat claims first with the `Claim:` naming the branch the coordinator will give the thread, then asks for the thread) rests on the coordinator being able to name a project thread's branch. Measured on this very thread (A2 below): it cannot. The branch is platform-assigned at thread creation (`claude/project-thread-` + a random suffix; 27 such heads on `origin`), the coordinator's opening message carried none, and the thread may push only that branch. So the 〈卡线程〉 handshake lines were left as they were until the ruling; the options as filed, ⛔ none picked by this thread (A was ruled by the maintainer):

- **A. Coordinator reads, seat claims, thread verifies.** The coordinator reads the new thread's branch from its session record the moment it is spawned (`get_session` on the child lists `outcomes[].git_info.branches` before any push — measured) and hands it to the seat in the same stroke; the seat claims; the thread's first act stays 「verify the newest `Claim:` names my branch」 and it starts as soon as the claim is up. Cost: one read per thread; the thread still waits for the seat, usually less than today because the read beats the thread's own report.
- **B. Today's handshake minus the probe push.** The thread reports its branch and waits; the seat claims; the thread starts. The empty-branch push (`os-dev.md` rule 1) is dropped for card threads because the branch is platform-designated and the push route is the harness's. Cost: zero protocol change on the seat side; the 5–10 minute wait the card measured stays. (The probe-push drop touches `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, outside this card's file surface either way.)
- **C. Claim first with the branch line filled later.** The seat claims with `Branch: pending` and the thread's first report fills it by a body edit of the claim comment. Cost: a claim comment that is edited after it is written, which the claim protocol (「认领评论时间戳是唯一仲裁」) does not foresee.

Two known overlaps, both trivial: `#25255` deletes SKILL.md L274, which this PR only renames (the merge takes the deletion); `#25247` and `#25348` move SKILL.md's count (317 and 319) while this PR leaves it at 318 under the 319 ceiling, so whichever lands last re-measures. `#25255`, `#25247` and `#25393` landed 13:14Z and were merged in (`bd78f67d`): two SKILL.md conflicts, both resolved as foreseen — the `director` row keeps this PR's rename and `#25255`'s `coordinator` row is added beneath it; `#25255`'s deletion of the 总监席 summons line wins over this PR's rename of it. The follow-up commit then wrote the deferred items (coordinator.md pointer and rename, 「派发令全文」 in both candidate lines) plus the two review flags (patrol line, cross-repo rule 5).
- **A2 (can the coordinator name the branch?)** — disproved. `get_session` on this thread shows the branch `claude/project-thread-hxtlri` in `session_context.outcomes[].git_repository.git_info.branches` at creation (04:51:59Z); the coordinator's opening note named no branch; `git ls-remote` had no such head until this thread pushed it; the suffix appears in neither the thread id nor the session id. So the branch is readable after spawn, not nameable before it — item 3 goes to the ruling batch as above.
- **A3 (SKILL.md 319/319 once `#25348` lands)** — holds and is respected: SKILL.md stayed at 318 lines until `#25348` landed and sat at 319/319 after the first merge and 318/318 after the second (the ruling-2A clause is in place on L75, net zero). No re-wrap used as payment; the two lines removed are the two mechanisms the card names.
- **A4 (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`)** — holds; the operating text names rules by file and section only; 87 files clean.

- The body's first line is the HTML-comment attribution block the project session requires; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Measured on the sibling PRs of this project, the relay read-back keeps it byte for byte. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.
- `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 5 was outside the claim's file surface at the first push; the seat widened the surface by that one line and the follow-up commit carries the review's exact 119-byte rewrite.

- The vocabulary 「车道项目 / 总监项目 / 项目席」 this PR introduces is left as written; card #25412 (PR #25427) re-words it after this PR lands, per the seat.
- Work was done in a linked worktree (`../objectstack-issue-25379`) on the designated branch; the primary checkout was left detached at `d12e650`. The empty-branch push was made before the first edit, as `os-dev.md` rule 1 asked then; the third commit exempts card threads from it per ruling 1A.
